title: fix(metadata-protocol): duplicatePackage keeps a copied field's key and name, and a bare object's view item name, in step with what they name
body:
Fixes #23538
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`duplicatePackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, ADR-0070 D4) promises to rewrite "every intra-package reference". Three copied names fell out of step with what they name. All edits are in the `duplicatePackage` region: the free-text rename, the row-name rename and `deepRewrite`. The source-row read is untouched.

1. **A field's key and its `name` agree.** The free-text regex had a right identifier boundary and no left one, and an object's `fields` keys are never renamed outside a reference site. So the field keyed `dupsrc_customer` was copied with `name: 'dupdst_customer'`, and `x_dupsrc_customer` with `name: 'x_dupdst_customer'`. Two rules now hold:
   - **A record entry's `name` that echoes its key follows the key** (`deepRewrite`). Both are kept, "through none", the reading consistent with the landed permission-field rule ("the field part is never read").
   - **Free text renames an object's name only as a whole identifier.** A left boundary is added: a negative lookbehind that refuses a match preceded by a letter, digit or underscore. `x_dupsrc_customer` stays in a description and in a view's `columns`, the way `renameName` swaps the prefix only at the start of a name.
2. **A view item's `OBJECT.VIEWKEY` name follows its object.** For a `view` row with a qualified name, the object part takes `renameMap`'s rename, whole, and the view key is left as stored: `ticket.board` copies as `dupdst_ticket.board`. That is exactly the rename its `object` property takes. An object the copy does not rename keeps its items' names. This also covers an outside object that carries the source prefix: `dupsrc_ext.board` used to become `dupdst_ext.board` while its `object` stayed `dupsrc_ext`.
3. **The noted view-item id inside a value reproduced, so it is carried here (triage scope).** A value that is a renamed view item's whole name follows it: a form action's `target: 'ticket.entry'` becomes `dupdst_ticket.entry`. This applies to whole values only, and only to names of view items this copy renames.

Mechanism assumptions (Zone 2), measured on `origin/main` `8226755ee9`:
- Item 1: **partly confirmed.** The missing left boundary explains `x_dupsrc_customer` only. A value EQUAL to the object's name (`dupsrc_customer`) needs no left boundary to match, so the left boundary alone does not satisfy the Done line. The field's `name` has to follow its key's decision. Both changes landed, each with its own pin and ablation.
- Item 2: **confirmed.** `renameName` renames only names with the source prefix. A bare object's item kept `ticket.board`, and `getMetaItem({ type: 'view', name: 'ticket.board' })` served the source (`packageId: com.qa.dupsrc`, `object: ticket`).

## Evidence (real kernel: ObjectKernel + ObjectQLPlugin, memory driver)

New pin file `packages/objectql/src/protocol-duplicate-package-names-in-step.test.ts`, 5 cases, each with its negative control:

| case | on `main` `8226755ee9` | on this head |
|---|---|---|
| field key and `name` agree; `x_dupsrc_customer` keeps both (neg. control); the data plane inserts by the key; the copied set's FLS rules land | red: `failed[]` holds `dupsrc_ops`, `security-fls-unknown-field` on `dupdst_customer.dupsrc_customer` and `dupdst_customer.x_dupsrc_customer` | green |
| free text renames only a whole identifier (description, view `columns`) | red: `see x_dupdst_customer.` | green |
| bare object's view item is `dupdst_ticket.board`; the by-name read serves the copy, and `ticket.board` serves the source | red: copy stored as `ticket.board` | green |
| view items of objects outside the package keep their names (`dupext_account.board`, `dupsrc_ext.board`) | red: `dupsrc_ext.board` copied as `dupdst_ext.board` | green |
| a form action's view-item target follows (prefixed control; outside-object negative control) | red: `target: 'ticket.entry'` | green |

Main run: `Tests  5 failed (5)`. Head run: `Tests  29 passed (29)` over the five duplicate suites (`names-in-step`, `unprefixed-object`, `permission-field-keys`, `objects-key-collision`, `protocol-package-lifecycle`).

**Ablations.** One per mutation, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed). Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` and `ablation-dist-preflight` (marker present in 2 built files). Then the pin file. Then the restore, proven by blob == HEAD `3d7ac7e2e7b3` and an empty `git diff HEAD`, then a rebuild and `--absent` preflight (marker absent from all 24 built files, tree clean).

| ablation | predicted | observed |
|---|---|---|
| A1: drop the left boundary | case 2 red | **4 red, 1 green: more diagnostics than predicted.** The copied list view's column `x_dupdst_customer` names no field of the copy, so the save door refused that view (`list-view-field-unknown`), which also reds cases 1, 3 and 4 |
| A2: drop "name follows key" | case 1 red | 1 red (case 1), 4 green |
| A3: view row back to the prefix swap | cases 3, 4 red | 2 red (cases 3, 4), 3 green |
| A4: drop the whole-value view-item rename | case 5 red | 1 red (case 5), 4 green |

## Tests and gates (final head `dbd69f7592`, after merging `origin/main` `086fa4640f`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: `Test Files 236 passed | 3 skipped (239)`, `Tests 28409 passed | 19 skipped`.
- `@objectstack/objectql` `--project local`, as two shards: 210 + 210 files, `Tests 4052 passed` + `Tests 4067 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 67 commands from a fresh tree. Every exit was captured before any pipe. `--ran` printed: `67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
  - The one is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it needs every package's `dist/`; a full `pnpm build` is outside this card's local scope). NOT MEASURED locally; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
  - The other 66 exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Residual, same family, not addressed here (class a, reported for the seat to file).** A value naming a FIELD spelled like a prefixed package object is still renamed by the free-text rewrite as if it named the object. The field keeps its key and now its `name`. Measured with field `dupsrc_customer` on `dupsrc_customer`:
  - On this head, a list view with `columns: ['full_name', 'dupsrc_customer']` is **refused at the copy**: `view/dupdst_customer.board failed author-time validation … config.columns[1] [list-view-field-unknown]`. A form view with `sections[].fields` naming it copies silently as `['full_name', 'dupdst_customer']`.
  - On `main` `8226755ee9` the list view copied with column `dupdst_customer`, which matches the renamed `name` but not the key the data plane addresses (`engine.insert('dupdst_customer', { dupdst_customer })` answers `Unknown field 'dupdst_customer'`).
  - So this change moves the list-view case from a silent dangling column to a loud refusal, just as #23536 moved the permission-set case the other way.
  - Closing it needs a semantics decision about a token that names both an object and a field. One option is to rename such a token only at object-reference sites, as a bare name already is. That decision is left open, not guessed.
- **Not measured, read from code:** a view CONTAINER name (no dot, e.g. `ticket_views`) is still renamed by the prefix swap alone, so a bare object's container keeps the source's name. A container name is ungrammared (no declared `OBJECT.` identity), so this is not a contract breach.
- **Ruled negative control, kept:** a view item of an object outside the package keeps its name, so the copy shares that name with the source's row.
- **File surface:** besides the claimed region, the pin and the changeset, a 6-line doc comment in the sibling pin `protocol-duplicate-package-permission-field-keys.test.ts` is updated. It described this defect as live ("renames such a field's `name` but not its `fields` key … a separate defect"), which this change makes false. It now points at the new pin file.
- The card's blocker #23537 landed as PR #23545 (`8226755ee9`). #23539 remains open and is untouched here (`referencedNamesAt`, `collectReferenceHits`, `findReferencesToMeta` and `reference-sites.ts` are not edited). PR #23469's source-row read line is not edited either.
